convention_rule: Four pedestals left-to-right map to P1-P4; the single green-lit pedestal marks the target.
basis: A: four statues on pedestals, third from left lit by a green lamp. B: four pedestals (urn, urn, statue, urn), third from left under a green beam. Both point to position 3 = P3, which is not client-correct (P1 is).
